<thought>The mass spectrum gives an exact mass of 179.0946, corresponding to the formula C10H13NO2. The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two doublets, 2 H each), a methoxy singlet at 3.81 ppm, and two aliphatic triplets (2 H each, J ≈ 7.4 Hz) consistent with a –CH₂‑CH₂‑CO‑NH₂ side chain attached to the ring. This matches the structure p‑methoxy‑phenethyl‑amide. Its SMILES is “COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N”.> 
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N</final_answer>
